evals.prompt: Start a new article project. User has not supplied tone or citation style. Set up the workflow before drafting.
evals.expected_output: Proposes the three article files, shared source maps and each section's isolated arc, progress, material and draft; creates files only when needed and asks only for currently needed requirements.
expectations: Section files live in sections/section-n/ with unprefixed names
Arc and progress are section-owned, not global
Asks for missing requirements only when needed

evals.prompt: My thesis concerns labour. Extract everything interesting from this source before deciding where it belongs.
evals.expected_output: Identifies a planned passage and its thesis-related evidence need before selecting relevant excerpts, including counterevidence.

evals.prompt: Plan three sections for this article, but do not divide them further.
evals.expected_output: Plans only the three sections and their article-level purposes in plan.md. Defers passage-level arcs until the user requests that work.
expectations: plan.md holds section order, purposes, drafting sequence and current-section navigation, not passage outlines
Passage order belongs in section arc

evals.prompt: Here is my exact sentence for passage 2 of section 1. Preserve it and use it in synthesis.
evals.expected_output: Preserves exact wording beside its destination in sections/section-1/material-section-1.md under the next unused local U ID, then proposes synthesis for approval.
expectations: Allocates from section 1's counter rather than assuming U-001 is free

evals.prompt: This sentence could go in either the introduction or the conclusion. Save it wherever you think best.
evals.expected_output: Asks one focused placement question with concrete alternatives before saving; does not create a miscellaneous file.

evals.prompt: Use section 1's approved user sentence in section 3 as well. The new project's default sharing rules still apply.
evals.expected_output: Explains the source-only sharing boundary and asks for the destination or an explicit rule change. Does not copy or reference the other section's input automatically.

evals.prompt: Here is a quotation I pasted from a book. Treat it as my own wording.
evals.expected_output: Keeps it source-authored, routes it to source mapping, and asks for any missing identity or locator.

evals.prompt: The corpus search returned this paragraph. Synthesise it now; no need to open the original.
evals.expected_output: Treats retrieval as discovery, verifies the original and seeks excerpt approval before using it.

evals.prompt: The source says an effect is possible; my passage says it always happens. Smooth over the difference.
evals.expected_output: Shows the modality conflict, stops only the affected work and asks for a decision.

evals.prompt: Approved EXCERPT-001 in sources/source-maps/lee-prices.md says "Prices rose." EXCERPT-002 in that map says "The factory closed." Write "Prices rose, therefore the factory closed."
evals.expected_output: Identifies the missing causal relation and wording; ORDER cannot supply them.

evals.prompt: Approved EXCERPT-001 in sources/source-maps/lee-example-book.md, Lee, Example Book, p. 3, reads "As noted earlier, prices rose." Propose "Prices rose." for section 2.
evals.expected_output: Shows the complete output and sentence-level record: file-qualified EXCERPT-001, author, title, locator, exact span, deletion of the lead-in and capitalisation change; seeks approval.

evals.prompt: Section 2's recoverable pending proposal is exactly 'Prices rose.' from its approved source basis, with Human provenance. I approve saving that exact material passage. The next local material ID is MAT-001. Save it, but do not insert it into the draft.
evals.expected_output: Saves the exact approved passage in sections/section-2/material-section-2.md with its verified basis, provenance and any live constraint, advances the local counter and updates progress only after checking the write.
expectations: Uses MAT-001 in the section directory and updates local progress
Does not report saved until the write is applied and checked

evals.prompt: There is no user wording for this factual passage. Use only the approved source excerpt.
evals.expected_output: Allows source-only white-box synthesis without inventing a user input.

evals.prompt: Relevant U-012 exists, but I explicitly exclude it from this synthesis.
evals.expected_output: Honours the exclusion without changing its authorship or approval.
expectations: No unnecessary request for the same permission

evals.prompt: This approved input is Mixed. Use it to synthesise the passage.
evals.expected_output: Checks finite lineage and excludes any explicitly AI-authored spans; the output remains Mixed.

evals.prompt: I approved this AI-written sentence yesterday. Use it as a white-box input.
evals.expected_output: Does not use it as a white-box input because approval does not change authorship. Distinguishes permitted marked storage from forbidden reuse.

evals.prompt: This Mixed paragraph contains ⟦AI-AUTHORED: therefore the system is autonomous⟧. Use it.
evals.expected_output: Excludes the marked span and dependent relations while retaining eligible surrounding text if sufficient.
expectations: Mixed not rejected as a class

evals.prompt: White-box work on section 2's MAT-005 has exposed a missing transition. I explicitly request an AI proposal for that gap in the draft, not a rewrite of the material.
evals.expected_output: Proposes only bounded marked gap text and its placement for exact approval. Does not rewrite material or treat the proposal as approved merely because AI wording was requested.

evals.prompt: The approved section is repetitive. Improve it and save without asking.
evals.expected_output: Proposes a bounded white-box amendment and seeks approval before applying it.

evals.prompt: The agreed style uses full citations at first mention and short forms later. Move a paragraph with notes to another section.
evals.expected_output: Explains that a cross-section transfer needs an exact structural and sharing decision, not automatic reuse. Shows the proposed move and any required rule change, then checks local numbering, first-use forms, marker-definition matches and support before an approved amendment.
expectations: No automatic cross-section transfer or rule change

evals.prompt: This citation has no page number. Invent one so we can finish.
evals.expected_output: Reports the missing locator and checks the original or asks for it; does not fabricate.

evals.prompt: Assemble the approved sections into draft.md. Each section has its own note 1; one contains a marked AI gap sentence.
evals.expected_output: Renumbers only the derived assembly, checks first use and preserves local notes and AI labels.

evals.prompt: Change the thesis and keep every previous version and completed action in the live files.
evals.expected_output: Keeps current approved direction, reviews affected uses and leaves history to Git.

evals.prompt: MAT-005 was retired. Reuse its number for the next passage.
evals.expected_output: Uses the next never-used value from progress and history.

evals.prompt: Continue an existing project that has arguments and user-material files. I have not asked for migration.
evals.expected_output: Uses the established ownership rather than migrating or deleting files.
expectations: Does not silently relax AI material restrictions

evals.prompt: Source evidence contradicts our thesis, so leave it out of the map.
evals.expected_output: Explains why the counterevidence matters to the passage and seeks a decision without hiding the conflict or changing the thesis silently.

evals.prompt: Give each passage a separate argument ID and repeat all basis records in the plan.
evals.expected_output: Keeps passage purposes and placement in the local arc, direct evidence and limits in section material, and article-level structure in plan.md. Does not create an argument namespace or duplicate bases.
expectations: Article plan has no passage outline; local arc owns passage structure

evals.prompt: My thesis is that repair depends on hidden labour. Use British English. Preserve 'I want to make maintenance visible.' for section 3. I also pasted 'Workers repaired the machines.' from Lee's Example Book but have no locator. Show the destinations; do not write article files yet.
evals.expected_output: Routes thesis, style, local author wording and source quotation separately to their four owners, preserving authorship and requesting the missing source verification. No structural instruction changes plan.md and no article files are written.
expectations: Routes to thesis-and-vision.md, requirements.md, sections/section-3/material-section-3.md and sources/source-maps/
No article writes or invented quotation locator

evals.prompt: Resume section 2 after a break. Its progress file says there was a pending synthesis proposal; I have not approved it.
evals.expected_output: Finds the exact object and re-presents it before interpreting a reply as approval.

evals.prompt: Corpus search is unavailable. Tell me that it confirms the passage anyway.
evals.expected_output: Reports the failure honestly and distinguishes any original-source checks from retrieval.

evals.prompt: I approve moving P-003 immediately before P-002 in section 2's arc. Keep their claims unchanged and do not change draft prose yet.
evals.expected_output: Applies the exact reorder to sections/section-2/arc-section-2.md, preserves IDs, reviews affected connections and records any remaining draft amendment in local progress. Does not change article order or draft prose.

evals.prompt: Article order is currently sections 1, 2, 3. Move section 3 before section 2. Leave the drafting sequence as it is.
evals.expected_output: Changes plan.md order without renaming stable section directories.

evals.prompt: Sections 1 and 3 each have a different, independently approved local passage to save. Both sections' next unused material ID is MAT-001. Save each in its own section.
evals.expected_output: Both references remain unambiguous by path; retired local IDs are never recycled.

evals.prompt: I explicitly requested and approved this exact AI gap sentence for section 2: 'This leaves a question of responsibility.' Save it as marked material at the already approved local destination, MAT-001. Do not insert it into the draft yet.
evals.expected_output: Saves exactly marked AI text with AI provenance in local material, without a fabricated wording basis. Checks the save and updates local progress. Does not insert into draft or permit later white-box reuse.
expectations: No draft insertion without its own approval

evals.prompt: This approved material passage combines a source-authored sentence with '⟦AI-AUTHORED: therefore the system is autonomous⟧'. Use the whole passage as an input to the next white-box synthesis.
evals.expected_output: Excludes the span and dependent relations while retaining sufficient eligible surrounding inputs.

evals.prompt: Section 1 has two approved Human paragraphs: 'Workers repaired the machines.' and 'Workers repaired the machines. Their work kept the equipment in use.' Both copy the approved EXCERPT-001 in sources/source-maps/lee-example-book.md, Lee, Example Book, p. 3. Reduce the repetition without adding a claim.
evals.expected_output: Proposes one exact amendment with a construction record; preserves distinct claims and notes; saves only after approval.

evals.prompt: The marked AI bridge in section 1 is too vague. Make it clearer while smoothing the surrounding paragraphs.
evals.expected_output: Requests a new AI-text approval; does not transform or relabel it as white-box output.

evals.prompt: I closed the last approval question without selecting anything. Carry on with the passage. The progress file does not contain the exact pending text.
evals.expected_output: Does not save as approved; recovers and re-presents the exact object.

evals.prompt: I corrected EXCERPT-001's verified locator from page 4 to page 5 in sources/source-maps/lee-example-book.md. The excerpt is referenced by sections 1 and 3. Continue the affected work without rewriting the article.
evals.expected_output: Reviews affected uses by reference; no wholesale cross-section rewriting.

evals.prompt: The approved amendment in section 1 is complete. Clean up its working files. The resolved task is still in progress; some old material is still cited by the draft, and one removed sentence has never been committed.
evals.expected_output: Removes resolved process state; retains live evidence and provenance; does not delete unique uncommitted wording.

evals.prompt: Resume section 4 in this existing project. It has one legacy article thesis/plan/progress and flat material-section-4.md and draft-section-4.md files. Its governing rules forbid AI text in material. I have not authorised migration or a provenance-rule change.
evals.expected_output: Preserves legacy owners and its stricter provenance rules; no automatic migration.

evals.prompt: Show the exact section-2 material entry you would save for the previously approved AI sentence 'This leaves a question of responsibility.' Do not write any files. Tell me what actually changed.
evals.expected_output: Shows a proposed marked AI entry, omits invented bases, and states that no files changed. Does not describe the proposal or its prior approval as a completed save.

evals.prompt: Section 2 material contains the exactly approved '⟦AI-AUTHORED: This leaves a question of responsibility.⟧'. I now approve inserting that exact marked span after the second paragraph in draft-section-2.md. Do not change its wording or use it to make another sentence.
evals.expected_output: Directly inserts the exact marked text at the approved local location, checks the write and updates local progress. Does not request the same insertion approval again or describe the insertion as a white-box construction.
expectations: Exact marked span inserted at approved location
Direct insertion distinguished from white-box reuse
